conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__" AND metric.labels.result="failed"

documentation.content: The monthly exit-kit check __JOB_NAME__ failed: converting the newest backup into standard files (SDF/CSV) did not work, its self-check found differences, or keeping the checked kit under `exit-kits/` in the bucket failed. The daily backup itself is not affected, but this month's long-term copy is missing, and the exit kit (README: "Restoring, or moving away from CDD") may not work on the current data. See `make logs JOB=exit-kit` (FAIL lines, "incomplete archive", or a traceback). A conversion problem: reproduce with `make exit-kit`, fix exit_kit.py, then `make deploy-exit-kit`. An archiving problem: an incomplete `exit-kits/<month>/<run>/` folder (no `manifest.json.done`) can't be completed or deleted by the job; the next backup run is archived into a new folder, or rerun with `make run-exit-kit` once a newer backup exists.
